### Observed differences

- Before, A22, A31, A32 and A37 each appeared exactly once in every trace (200 of 200). In the later window, A22 appears in about 54 in 100 traces and each of A31, A32 and A37 in about 47 in 100, still once per trace when present; A20, A21, A23 and A26 continue to appear in every trace in both windows. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, REL002, REL009]

- Before, A20 was always followed by one of A31, A32, A37 (about 31 to 35 in 100 each) and reached A23 only four steps later, after all three had run. In the later window, A20 leads directly to A23 in about 199 of 200 traces, and a block member occurs within five steps after A20 in only about 1 trace. [DIR001, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004]

- The block changed position relative to A23 and A21. Before, each of A31, A32, A37 came before A23 and before A21 in 100 in 100 traces, and the last block activity led to A23 (about a third of each block activity's outgoing transitions). In the later window, A23 precedes the block in about 93 of 200 traces (reverse order in about 1), A21 precedes it, and the block activities now lead to A26 (about 29 to 36 in 100 of their outgoing transitions) instead of to A23 (at most about 1 in 100). [REL014, REL015, REL016, REL006, REL007, REL008, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008]

- A21's routing changed: before, it always led to A22; in the later window it leads to A22 in about 54 in 100 of its outgoing transitions and to one of A31, A32, A37 in about 46 in 100 (about 14 to 17 in 100 each). [DIR002, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008]

- A22 and the block became mutually exclusive. Before, they always co-occurred with the block first; in the later window they co-occur in about 1 of 200 traces, A22 runs without the block in about 53 in 100, and the block runs without A22 in about 47 in 100. Correspondingly, A21 reaches A26 two steps later in about 54 in 100 traces (via A22, as before) and four steps later in about 46 in 100, with the three block activities in between. [REL011, REL012, REL013, LAG005, REL010, REL017, REL018, REL019]

- The block's internal order stays unfixed in both windows: its activity pairs occur in both orders in similar shares, and the three always run together when they run at all (before in every trace, in the later window in about 47 in 100). [REL020, REL021, REL022]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

Screening tested 94 control-flow units and 39 items qualified, against roughly 0.47 expected if nothing had changed, so the volume of flagged behaviour is far beyond what random re-splits of an unchanged process produce; each item's difference also exceeds about 995 of 1000 random re-splits. [OCC001, DIR001, REL014, LAG001]

The evidence supports the following structural possibility: the three-activity block A31/A32/A37, previously mandatory and placed between A20 and A23, now runs as an optional branch after A21 and before A26, taken in about 47 in 100 later-window cases; in those cases A22 is not executed, while A22 — previously in every case — runs in about 54 in 100 cases and still leads to A26. A20 now connects directly to A23 instead of being separated from it by the block. The main signs are the successor change at A20, the reversed order between A23 (and A21) and each block activity, the block's rerouting from A23 to A26, the near-perfect mutual exclusivity of A22 and the block, and the participation drops, all seen consistently across occurrence, direction, relation and lag indicators. Limitations: the six lag profiles for the block's new distance from A20 and A23 rest on a single observation each, and the events now lying between A23 and A21 are not covered by the evidence, so the block's exact insertion point relative to unseen work remains open. A competing reading the evidence cannot exclude is that the drop of A22 and the running of the block are two independent changes that happen to align, although their co-occurrence in about 1 of 200 traces makes a single either-or choice the reading most consistent with the data. [DIR001, REL014, REL006, DIR003, REL011, OCC001, LAG001, LAG005]

Other differences: in about 1 of 200 later-window traces the earlier pattern still appears — A20 is followed directly by block members and reaches A23 four steps later, and a block activity precedes A21. [DIR001, LAG001, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, REL006, REL007, REL008]
